label: Brow Projection
semantics: Forward growth of the supraorbital torus (brow band) on the skull layer. 0 = base; +1.0 = brow-study native +100 (Krapina Neanderthal anchor, midorbit chord 0.126 L vs 0.066 L baseline); +1.5 = native +150 (gorilla anchor [E]). Negative values recess the band below the modern-human zero. v1 form: masked rigid translation of the band; sulcus carving belongs to head.brow.shelf.

region.mask_rule: geodesic falloff from BrowL+BrowR vertex groups, plateau 0.025 L, falloff to 0.140 L. No group exclusion (base groups overlap wholesale). Glabella/medial band moves with the torus (anatomically part of it); the low nasal bridge carries falloff-tail weights only. A hard stop guard per brow-study §5.8 is future work — guard prototypes introduced folds (see QA).

range.endpoint_anchor: at +1.0, the midorbit brow anchor vertices sit 0.060 L forward of neutral (L = head length)

provenance.source: brow-study.md §5.1 (Smith & Ranyard chords via Ahern, Lee & Hawks 2002 [S]; scale-free form [D]; gorilla extreme [E])
